_doc: PUBLIC LAUNCH SWITCH (owner, 2026-11-09) — the ONLY place that opens online booking on fish-cabo.com. false: the production site behaves as before the booking system (BOOK NOW → /fishing-boats, chat → /contact, the original Stripe/Wise/PayPal buttons on the boat pages, no BOOK THIS BOAT, no /book-now page, booking API closed (503); /booking-admin and the signed Stripe webhook stay available). true (one commit, one deploy): every BOOK NOW / BOOK THIS BOAT / chat link → /book-now, old direct-payment buttons removed, /book-now and the booking API open — all at the same time. Staging and local builds (not PUBLIC_SITE_ENV=production / not SITE_ENV=production) are always open. Change only with the owner's explicit authorization.
_doc_card: CARD PAYMENTS (owner, 2026-11-09: Wise-only launch while Stripe identity verification blocks the live key). false: on production the card option is shown disabled ('Card payments temporarily unavailable'), no Stripe Checkout Session can be created, Wise works normally. To enable cards later: owner sets the live STRIPE_SECRET_KEY secret, then one commit sets this to true and adds BOOKING_LIVE=approved — no rebuild of the booking system. Staging/local builds ignore it (cards follow the Stripe key there). 2026-11-09 17:15 (owner): live key installed — cards enabled; BOOKING_LIVE=approved set in wrangler.jsonc. Nothing is open to customers until PUBLIC_BOOKING_LAUNCHED is true: Stripe Checkout Sessions are only created by /api/booking/reserve and /api/booking/pay, which answer 503 while booking is closed.
_doc_paypal: PAYPAL (owner, 2026-11-09): PayPal is a PERMANENT payment method (deposit + 6% PayPal processing fee on the deposit only). Only the connection of the owner's PayPal account is postponed. false: on production PayPal is shown as a normal option, but no PayPal order can be created — a customer who picks it sees 'PayPal checkout is not yet available' and can switch to Stripe or Wise without losing the booking. To activate: owner installs PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID / PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET (secrets) and PAYPAL_WEBHOOK_ID, PAYPAL_ENV=live, PAYPAL_LIVE=approved, then one commit sets this to true. Change only with the owner's explicit authorization.
